finite_witness.kind: Source parsing, set geometry and arithmetic only; no target class, world, RNG stream or native algorithm executed.

overlapping_bases.condition: Both controllers and rod pillars are otherwise valid; cells contain correctly registered parts, no extra third-party binding routine.
overlapping_bases.old_second_owner: checkAndSetTarget rejects live first owner inside its structure
overlapping_bases.current: block identity checks alone permit both

sky_predicates.condition: Transparent non-air glass above the tip, valid completed skylight at queried point equals 15, no extra obstruction or interceptor.

height_tooltip_boundary_preserved.limit: Existing original tooltip/code discrepancy, not a newly introduced port difference.

energy_metadata.current_emitting_query: EU downward when formed, or theoretical
energy_metadata.limit: Actual tick size already matches source. Do not blindly restore inconsistent original getter bug.

output_budget_example.condition: An API consumer invokes a valid pull with sufficient demand after the push; not a measured built-in plant. Energy remains conserved.

old_overoffer_excluded.policy: Keep the current bound; do not reintroduce source overdraw when final receiver accepts 13 of an offer16 despite only 8 stored.

ordinary_clone.condition: No Ctrl key, creative player, valid client BE snapshot (energy may be nonzero after initial synchronization); no external pick cancellation.
ordinary_clone.old_pick: writeItemNBT has name/paint/kept inventory/covers, no lightning energy writer
ordinary_clone.current_clone: saves full BE gt.energy plus inherited data before normal inventory pick
ordinary_clone.ordinary_drop: CoverDropMixin still clears full machine state; this is a separate pick path.

external_primary_evidence.authority: Official MinecraftForge repository, 1.7.10 branch; read through web open on 2026-10-21.
external_primary_evidence.hash_limit: Hash of the normalized returned patch lines, not an asserted raw HTTP artifact digest.
external_primary_evidence.claim: The normal old lightning hit-list path invokes the entity strike callback unless the Forge event cancels it. The local original spawns that normal entity; modern visualOnly skips its hit list.
external_primary_evidence.limit: Only this callback contrast is claimed; no complete old-native fire implementation, all entity conversions or modern copper side effects are accepted.

excluded_candidates: Ordinary harvested machine energy state is cleared by configured CoverDropMixin; clone/pick is separate.

A repeated block in BlockEntityType.Builder.of is not a second registered controller ID; the native builder constructs an ImmutableSet. The old generic LightningRodControllerBlock is not the registered17998 implementation.
Source height gate uses controllerY+length, despite tooltip tip wording; both versions share that offset discrepancy.
Modern int rodLength and actual build-height loop avoid original signed-byte overflow; do not restore 1.7.10 overflow or fixed height limits.
visualOnly suppresses hit-list callbacks but is not a guarantee of no world side effects; modern initial tick still calls powerLightningRod, copper handling and gameEvent.
Original multiblock Base10 overrides default environmental checks as no-op; do not add new rain/fire failures just because emitted energy is EU.
provenance: Original lightning file GregTech-6 Team2025 / Gregorius Techneticies, LGPL-3.0-or-later; other sources keep their own headers. Official Forge patch is reference evidence. No original/native method bodies or assets newly copied into production.
limitations: No target class initialization or Java compilation, Gradle, tests, world construction, actual strike/RNG/play effects, energy API execution, pick/placement, save restart, build or push.
Finite cases are source arithmetic/geometry and conditional consumer traces, not TPS, a game reproduction, addon breakage or complete old-native lightning implementation.
Energy-query and strike-effect policy differences are recorded, not automatically reverted to old interface bugs or damaging effects.

root_revalidation.kind: Source hashes, full selected execution streams and literal positions, exact native entries and documentation checks only.
